The real cause was preprocess-sections.sh trapping a CRLF record's trailing CR *inside* the bold markers it generates (`**Header<CR>**`) and writing that back into the source; a lone CR makes git classify the file as non-text, which silently disables core.autocrlf=input for it, so its CRLF endings then diff against CI's LF blobs on every line. A narrow `.gitattributes` (`*.md text eol=lf`) would remove the hazard class entirely at the cost of a one-time normalization of those 50 files. dp's call; no longer urgent.
